title: [Feature request] G6 Sensor Error as notification
body:
Would it be possible to have a "Sensor Error" notification via SMS or via NSClient so we as carers can understand remotely that "Missing BG readings" is because of a faulty sensor?

Otherwise is hard to understand what the issue is. Long distance and out of BT range etc.

I don't know if it is possible to pass such a message from BYODA but would be very nice to have as a feature.

Thank you!

comments.body: AAPS doesn't get this info from BOYDA
